12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
13: - Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
14: - Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.

Built **Wildspire**, a playable 3D creature-battle game with custom low-poly models, a forest arena, card-based turns, four escalating encounters, recruit-or-continue choices, and win/lose endings.

Assumption: “Creat 3d models” meant adding 3D models to the existing game, so I transformed the existing battle into a 3D game. Three.js loads from a CDN, so playing requires an internet connection. I verified the game in Chromium and saved a screenshot at `screenshots/latest.jpg`.
